titles: Tant qu'il y aura des profs
notes: Landscape, straight-on and close, one shelf of a street library (little free library) against a blown-out white background in bright daylight, no glare; twelve books, most leaning at an angle, the leftmost lying open and the top one lying flat. French, English and Hebrew. Titles as printed: the Abellio Livre de Poche spine reads 'Les yeux d'Ézéchiel sont ouverts' upside down in small pink type; the Hebrew paperback beside Tant qu'il y aura des profs reads הקיץ של אביה (Gila Almagor) in red; the Warner paperback spine reads 'Money® Car Shopping Made Easy' and the brand is kept as the title's first word. Left out: the black hardback lying on top with faint Hebrew lettering on the spine (not readable), the pale open book at the far left with only a 'Goldmann' publisher mark, the thin tan booklet between the Abellio and Castle Rackrent (a drawing, no title), and the thin white spine behind Edgeworth. The Confessions cover shows a boy from behind on a library ladder; no face. Drafted by claude-sonnet-5 (extraction 108), verified by an agent.
